Visitor replaces subscript with custom template

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitSubscript(NodeContext ctx, String text) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("~%s~", text));
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>H<sub>2</sub>O is water.</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
